name: personal-knowledge
description: Skills that keep a personal local data store on your machine. Currently get-chrome-history, which reads the Chrome browsing history added since the last run, sorts it by known service, and summarizes your interests, adding the domains it classifies to its own knowledge.json

chrome_profile.title: Chrome profile
chrome_profile.description: Directory name of the Chrome profile get-chrome-history reads (for example Default or Profile 1, as under ~/Library/Application Support/Google/Chrome/ or ~/.config/google-chrome/). Empty means Default
